Subject: APX MAP & EB meeting cadence — alignment and close milestones

Hi Naftali —

Per our conversation yesterday, I put together a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and a suggested evaluation timeline to get us to a late-Oct close. Attached: APX_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx and a short EvalPlan_Guidance.pdf with recommended test prompts and metrics.

High-level asks / proposed owners:
- Executive sponsor mapping: confirm ACME execs and deputies (row in the attached matrix). Owner: Marissa (we'll draft, you confirm).
- EB meeting cadence: propose 45-min exec briefing + 60-min technical evaluation review. Suggest 9/28 for an initial EB slot and 10/19 as the final decision meeting.
- Evals: Redwood to deliver scoped eval harness by 9/23; Apex to run with two internal datasets and provide feedback by 10/05.

Can you confirm sponsor names and whether the 9/28/10/19 cadence looks feasible? If procurement needs different windows, loop them in.

Thanks — look forward to locking dates.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa —

Thanks for the MAP and the eval outline. High-level: the cadence looks reasonable. Quick notes from my side:
- Executive sponsor: I'm confirming with our SVP, Elena Morales, and will get back with final sponsor + alternate by EOD Monday (9/21).
- 9/28 works for Elena but she'd prefer mornings (PST). 10/19 also works.
- Procurement should be looped for pricing SOW items — cc'ing procurement@apexretail.com. Expect an initial procurement checklist by 9/24.

One question: on the eval harness — can Redwood provide a short sample run (5–10 queries) against the recommended config so we can sanity-check latency/cost before our internal run?

Cheers,

Naftali / team —

Thanks for the quick reply and for confirming Elena's morning preference. I've attached an updated Sponsor_Matrix_v2.csv with titles, availability windows, and recommended talking points for each exec. Highlights:
- Proposed EB agenda (60 min exec + 75 min tech deep-dive):
  1) 10 min introductions and desired outcomes (execs)
  2) 20 min Redwood demo focused on production economics and privacy controls
  3) 30 min customer-specific evaluation findings and Q&A
  4) 25 min rollout / procurement + timeline (procurement + legal callouts)
- Can we lock the 9/28 EB for an internal prep + sponsor touchpoint? I recommend a 30-min prep with Elena two days prior (9/26) to set expectations.

Regarding the sample run: yes — we can do a 10-query sanity run. Karthik, could your team prepare a minimal workload snapshot and a cost estimate by EOD 9/22?

Next steps / asks:
- Naftali: confirm Elena + alternate by EOD today if possible.
- Procurement@apexretail.com: share initial checklist / any required security docs we should pre-send.
- Karthik: sample run + cost estimate by 9/22.

Thanks — attaching Sponsor_Matrix_v2.csv.

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. Quick summary and agreed next steps so we have a clean MAP checkpoint: 

Confirmed dates / owners
- 9/22: Redwood delivers 10-query sanity run (Karthik) — results to Apex by EOD 9/22.
- 9/23: Redwood delivers lightweight evaluation harness and run instructions.
- 9/26: 30-min sponsor prep with Elena (tentative AM slot; Marissa & Ben to run).
- 9/28: Initial EB (45-min exec + 75-min tech) — objective: alignment on desired outcomes and acceptance criteria.
- 10/05: Apex returns eval results + feedback to Redwood.
- 10/19: Final EB decision meeting (confirm rollout approach + procurement next steps).
- 10/28: Target contract signature (SOW in legal review; Karthik flagged SOW draft by 10/01).

Immediate asks
- Naftali: confirm Elena's alternate and final AM slot for 9/26 prep (reply-all).
- Procurement: please send your checklist and any required security docs by 9/24 so we can prep the EB procurement section.

I've updated the MAP in-place and will send a fresh version after we lock sponsor names. Attaching the current artifacts again for visibility.

If there are any blockers that would push the 10/28 target, call them out now so we can adjust the MAP.

Appreciate the partnership — we want to make this as low friction as possible.

Warmly,
